dossier.headline: Wall Street ends a volatile week higher despite Nvidia's CEO exit
dossier.summary: US stocks whipsawed through the week of November 9: a sharp Monday rally, a dip on hot inflation data, an AI rebound, then two down days after Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO. On Friday the S&P 500 fell about 0.4% and the Nasdaq about 0.9%, but the S&P 500 still rose about 2.5% for the week, the Nasdaq 2.3% and the Dow 2.1%.
